entities.name: Herodotus's Account of the Persian Wars
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The first major work of historical investigation, Herodotus's Histories (c. 440 BCE) is the primary eyewitness-adjacent account of the Greco-Persian Wars (499-449 BCE). By traveling to Egypt, Babylon, and Scythia to interview witnesses and examine evidence, Herodotus established the methodology of historical inquiry that earns him the title "Father of History."
